title: Senior Software Engineer (IC3 - Backend)
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**About Servicing Platform**
At Wise, we are on a mission to build money without borders -instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Behind every transaction lies a critical responsibility: holding over £20B+ in customer balances, moving £145B+ across borders annually and protecting innocent customers from fraudsters, sanctioned entities and financial crime.
  
  
The Servicing Platform sits at the very heart of this mission. We build the foundational identity engines, high-throughput risk platforms and real-time APIs that power all customer servicing, onboarding and risk decisions across Wise globally.
  
  
As Wise expands its engineering presence in Hyderabad, we are building core execution capability to modernize our identity and risk infrastructure. As a Backend Engineer (IC3), you will tackle real-time scale challenges, execute complex system migrations and onboard products to next-generation risk APIs that gate billions in cross-currency volume.
  
  
**What You Will Be Working On**
**You will join a high-velocity engineering squad focused on platform adoption and system reliability:**

* Platform Implementation & Migrations: Drive the hands-on technical integration of Wise products onto our modernized Identity, Account and Risk APIs. You will unblock product and FinCrime squads by executing key migrations such as deprecating legacy models and services and improving integrations into Fin Crime domains.
* High-Performance Infrastructure: Build, maintain and optimize low-latency, high-availability microservices. You’ll work toward achieving sub second risk check speeds for real-time transactions.
* Data Lineage & Governance: Implement robust schemas, data contracts and immutable data flows to ensure complete auditability and data consistency across the full customer and transaction lifecycle.
* Operational Excellence: Maintain the operational health (SLAs/SLOs, monitoring, alerting) of critical platform components. Participate in incident resolution and post-mortems to ensure zero downtime for money moving out of Wise.
* Global Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (Product, FinCrime, Risk Assessment) and engineering peers across London, Tallinn and Hyderabad.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About us**

Our platforms are used by thousands of care professionals every day, supporting better outcomes for residents, improving compliance, and helping teams focus on what matters most people.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build and maintain high-quality software for our mCare products. You will own features and technical improvements from design through to production, contribute to system design, and help ensure our solutions are scalable, maintainable and secure.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy as part of a cross-functional squad, partnering with Product, QA and engineering colleagues to deliver outcomes. You will also support peers through code reviews, mentoring and knowledge sharing, and help improve team practices. We use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate delivery; sound engineering judgement, quality and compliance remain essential.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, develop, test and maintain software using C# and .NET across backend and frontend technologies
* Deliver product features and technical improvements across the full software development lifecycle.
* Work with Product Managers and QA to understand the problem, refine the solution and ensure the work is testable, including agreeing clear acceptance criteria
* Independently investigate and solve moderately complex technical problems, evaluating trade-offs and long-term impact; contribute to technical design and architecture discussions that balance scalability, performance, maintainability and security
* Write and maintain automated tests for new and changed code, including unit, integration and end-to-end coverage where appropriate
* Review peers’ code and provide clear, timely and constructive feedback that supports quality and shared learning
* Take ownership of significant work from design through release and production support; identify risks, dependencies and blockers early and follow through to resolution
* Plan and manage your work effectively, contribute to sprint planning and communicate progress and trade-offs to the squad and stakeholders
* Collaborate across teams, articulate technical decisions, document relevant context and share learnings from delivery and retrospectives
* Mentor and support less-experienced engineers, encourage collaborative problem-solving and contribute to an inclusive, positive team culture
* Use AI-assisted tools to support analysis and development, validate their outputs, and share useful practices while safeguarding quality, security and compliance
* Propose practical improvements to code, tools and team workflows, and help evaluate their impact

**What we're looking for**

* Strong commercial experience developing software using C# and .NET Framework and/or modern .NET (including .NET 8+)
* Experience building and maintaining web-based applications across backend and frontend layer
* Experience designing and delivering features or systems, with an understanding of scalability, performance and maintainability trade-offs
* Strong understanding of software quality, including clean code, testability, maintainability and secure design
* Experience writing automated tests as a standard part of development and contributing to code reviews
* Experience working in an Agile product development environment and using source control, CI/CD pipelines and work-tracking tools
* Confidence using AI-assisted developer tools in day-to-day work and applying judgement to verify outputs for correctness, quality, security and compliance.

**Bonus points**

* Experience with Blazor or another modern UI framework
* Experience with SQL databases, including schema design and optimisation
* Experience building or supporting SaaS or multi-tenant systems
* Familiarity with Azure or other cloud platforms, including containerised workloads such as Kubernetes
* Experience designing and consuming APIs
* Understanding of authentication and authorisation concepts such as OAuth2 and OIDC
* Experience in healthcare, care management, pharmacy technology or another compliance-driven domain
* Experience with high-availability or business-critical systems.

Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture, and you will not be starting from a blank page. You will build on our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting.
  
  
Agentic Systems & Enterprise Integration

* Hands-on LLM experience: Demonstrable experience with LLM APIs, including prompting, function/tool calling and structured outputs, through professional work, internships, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Camera Bring-up Engineer**
to join our Advanced Engineering BSP team. This hands-on role will lead the integration, bring-up, and validation of automotive camera modules on advanced SoC platforms.

You will own camera integration from hardware review through validated first-frame capture, working with YUV422 and RAW (Bayer and monochrome) sensors over MIPI CSI-2 and GMSL/FPD-Link SerDes interfaces. * Develop and maintain sensor drivers, V4L2 sub-device drivers, device-tree configurations, and SerDes software.
* Debug camera issues across sensor, ISP, SerDes, MIPI PHY, CSI-2 receiver, and SoC software layers.
* Validate pixel formats, data integrity, image quality, and long-duration system stability.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers for hardware-level troubleshooting.
* Support Android Automotive camera integration, including Camera HAL, EVS, and CTS/VTS testing.
* Collaborate with hardware teams, SoC vendors, sensor suppliers, and SerDes vendors.
* Develop reusable bring-up procedures, validation tools, and technical documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of embedded Linux, Android, or QNX BSP development.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience bringing up both YUV422 and RAW (Bayer or monochrome) cameras to validated first frame.
* Strong understanding of MIPI CSI-2, D-PHY, pixel formats, data types, virtual channels, and ECC/CRC.
* Experience with GMSL2/3 or FPD-Link III/IV SerDes camera interfaces.
* Strong C/C++ and Python programming skills.
* Linux kernel driver experience, including V4L2, media controller, and device tree, or equivalent SoC camera framework experience.
* Ability to read schematics and debug hardware using oscilloscopes and logic/protocol analyzers.
* Strong problem-solving, technical documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Qualcomm automotive camera platforms (CSID, IFE, RDI, QCX) or NVIDIA, NXP, TI, or Renesas SoCs.
* Automotive camera experience, including surround-view, rear-view, DMS, or OMS applications.
* Experience with Android Automotive Camera HAL and EVS.
* Knowledge of HDR, exposure/gain control, image tuning, and monochrome NIR cameras.
* Familiarity with ISO 26262 and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 Days:**
  Successfully bring up a YUV422 camera on the target platform and establish a repeatable bring-up process.
* **6 Months:**
  Independently complete a RAW camera bring-up with exposure/gain control and stability validation.
* **12 Months:**
  Lead camera integration for new platforms or sensor families while delivering reusable drivers, tools, and technical guidance.

**The Ideal Candidate:**
A hands-on camera engineering expert who can independently bring up both YUV422 and RAW cameras, troubleshoot complex hardware/software integration issues, and help advance automotive camera platform development.

We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.
  
  
If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
**Staff Data Scientist – Supply Chain Operations Research**
We are seeking a Staff Data Scientist : Supply Chain Operations Research to join our Supply Chain Planning Science team in Bangalore. In this role, you will lead the development and productionization of advanced Operations Research solutions that power critical supply chain decisions across warehouse routing, transportation, network planning, inventory, and purchase order allocation.
  
  
As a founding science leader for the India-based Operations Research team, you will own OR workstreams end-to-end — from problem formulation and methodology selection to production deployment, experimentation, and measurable business impact. You will partner closely with Supply Chain Planning, Engineering, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, and Science teams across Bangalore and Palo Alto to translate complex operational problems into scalable optimization solutions.
  
  
Success in this role means building production-grade optimization systems that materially improve supply chain efficiency, establishing strong scientific standards for the OR organization, and raising the technical bar through mentorship, collaboration, and AI-native approaches to Operations Research.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Operations Research & Workstream Ownership**

* Own Operations Research workstreams end-to-end across areas such as dynamic warehouse routing, shipping cost optimization, multi-modal transportation, network flow, inventory planning, and PO allocation
* Translate complex supply chain and operational challenges into well-defined optimization problems and measurable objectives
* Select and apply appropriate optimization methodologies including Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP), Constraint Programming (CP), vehicle routing, network flow, metaheuristics, and stochastic optimization
* Develop, productionize, and continuously improve optimization models based on real-world operational feedback and measurable business outcomes
* Partner with Planning Tools and Engineering teams to define requirements for solver integration, feature pipelines, model serving, evaluation infrastructure, and production systems

**Methodology & Scientific Rigor**

* Establish and maintain high methodological standards for Operations Research across the organization
* Evaluate different optimization approaches using rigorous, data-driven experimentation rather than relying on a single modeling methodology
* Define experimentation standards including clean data splits, historical backtesting, model validation, and robust evaluation frameworks
* Work effectively with sparse, noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary operational data
* Challenge assumptions, validate hypotheses rigorously, and be willing to reject approaches that do not demonstrate measurable impact

description:
**About The Team**
The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. **About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and technically deep Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to execute technical strategy across our entire Identity and Access Security management program. This domain spans a broad and increasingly complex set of disciplines, including Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Access Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Non-Human Identity (NHI) security, and the emerging space of Agentic Identity security.

At the same time, this role carries significant cross-functional weight: you will be partnering closely and continuously with Information Security, IT, Engineering and the many application-owning teams distributed across the company, driving the identity security initiatives in alignment with the overall business objectives.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Solution Design Design and build IAM solutions — including configurations, integrations, and workflows — that align with evolving business requirements, security policies and regulatory requirements (eg., SOX, GDPR).
* Application Onboarding & Integration Lead the onboarding of applications into IAM platforms, integrating across diverse systems including major cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and in-house systems.
* Build automation and policy-as-code frameworks Manage identity access policies as versioned, auditable code — using source control, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code to automate identity and access management changes instead of manual, ticket-driven processes.

* Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go), with experience in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., Terraform, GitHub Actions) preferred.

title: Pod Lead, Delivery Architect
description:
**What Amphare is**

Amphare Technologies builds governed, AI-native software delivery. The method is atomikd: scope is decomposed into machine-checkable units, each with a contract and an evidence grade, scheduled in waves and shipped inside a release envelope. The kernel is AmphSE: it sits above the coding agents and enforces the gates. The instrument is CodeSentinel: it reads the code and grades the evidence. The map is RepoGraph: the code graph every atom is planned against. The proof is a services pod that delivers real client software with all three and feeds what it learns back into the product.

The hybrid is deliberate. Service work funds the product and tests it against reality. The product makes the service faster, and lets us show a client exactly what was built, how it was verified, and by whom. Showing the client that is the business.

**Why this role exists**

Someone has to hold the whole project: the client's actual problem, the architecture that answers it, the estimate the business signed, the waves that get it built, and the evidence that proves it shipped. In a traditional firm that is a project manager, an architect, a scrum master and a BA, plus a steering committee. Here it is you, with three strong colleagues and a kernel that enforces the gates you set. You are the person a client trusts because you can draw the system on one page and defend every box. You are the person the pod trusts because when the critical path is blocked, you open the editor.

**What you own**

* The engagement. One at a time for the first pod. From sales handover to acceptance: scope, commercial envelope (what the fixed price can absorb), risk, client relationship, and the decision to say no when the evidence says no. Pricing new work and signing contracts stay with the founder.
* Solution shape. Architecture, stack choice for the client's constraints (we are stack-agnostic by principle), integration boundaries, non-functional requirements, and the trade-offs written down where the client can read them. You are accountable for the user experience too; specialist design is engaged per engagement from outside the pod.
* The Epic Map and the estimate. Decomposition to the level where effort can be measured and compared with what we actually spent. Your estimates are checked against outcomes every wave. Wave scheduling and the release envelope. What ships, in what order, with what dependencies, under what gate. Short, written, evidence-first.
* Pod governance. The gates agents and humans pass through, the evidence grades we accept, the retros that change the method. "AI proposes, humans approve" is a rule you enforce, including on yourself.
* The pod itself. Growing the three people beside you, and writing down how this pod works so the next pod can copy it.

**Who we are looking for**

* You have shipped production software as an engineer and later run delivery for teams larger than this pod, and you know what that cost.
* You have personally fixed a bad estimate, in front of a client, with numbers rather than apologies.
* You can draw a system on one page and answer "why not the obvious alternative" for every component.
* You have read code an agent wrote for you closely enough to send it back. More than once.
* You have written requirements, test plans and release notes yourself because nobody else was going to, and they were good.
* You can name a ceremony you removed from a team and what you replaced it with.
* You are commercially literate: blended rates, margin, fixed-price risk, what a change request costs.

*Signals this is not your role*

* You manage through status meetings and feel exposed without a PMO.
* You last committed code three or more years ago and are comfortable with that.
* You believe "architect" means not touching the keyboard.
* You see AI coding tools as a productivity add-on for juniors.
* You cannot do your best work until scope is frozen.
* You prefer to be told the method rather than to improve it.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is building satellite-to-device (NTN) connectivity infrastructure connecting mobile network operators worldwide. As part of our growing InfoSec organization, we're hiring a
**Senior Cloud Security Engineer**
to own the security posture of our cloud infrastructure across AWS/GCP environments supporting our satellite network operations, ground infrastructure, and enterprise systems.
  
  
This is a foundational hire on our Platform Security pillar — you'll build controls, tooling, and processes largely from the ground up in a multi-cloud, multi-jurisdictional environment (India, US & EU). You'll building a modern InfoSec function for a company defining a new category of connectivity infrastructure. You'll have direct influence over architecture and tooling decisions rather than inheriting a legacy stack.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud security architecture across AWS or GCP environments (IAM, network segmentation, workload security, secrets management, encryption/KMS)

* Partner with platform/DevOps engineering to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)

* 2+ years in application or cloud security: AppSec, pentesting, security engineering or detection.
* Hands-on experience with at least one LLM application, your own or at work.
* Clear written English. Your reports go to engineers and to customers.

What we offer

* Work on AI security problems most teams have not met yet, with a founder who has worked in the field for years.
* Your findings shape the product our customers use to check their own AI.
* Remote work, with hours that overlap with India and Europe.

How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and tell us about one AI or application security issue you found and how it was fixed, or apply directly and start the short written screening: https://certify.ayurak.com/apply/CCb0XhAr9L5k6daavU4uTj6G

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
**Embedded Engineer**

Location: Bangalore | Full-Time | Experience: 2-5 Years

**About Rekise Marine**

Rekise Marine is building autonomous ships and submarines that operate in the world's most hostile environments. We're executing India's flagship autonomous submarine project — the Jalkapi XLAUV — on order from the Indian Navy. This is an unmanned submarine weighing over 20 tons that can travel 5,000+ kilometers autonomously and operate in the ocean for 30+ days at a time.

We're creating some of the largest autonomous robots in the world, machines with direct impact on the global economy and national security. While autonomous cars in India may still be a dream, autonomous ships and submarines are already a reality, and it is possible to build for the world from India.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Embedded Engineer who is comfortable working across the full hardware lifecycle - PCB and electrical design, wiring and harnessing, sensor integration, and bench testing and bring-up. This is an individual-contributor role for an engineer who enjoys breadth across these areas and can own tasks end to end in a fast-moving build environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Schematics and PCB design/layout in a standard EDA tool, including BOM preparation and component selection.
* Design wiring harnesses and interconnects — cable routing, connectorisation, and electrical/wiring drawings and participate in their fabrication.
* Integrate, bench-test, and characterise sensors and electronics (IMU, DVL, sonar, pressure, leak, and similar).
* Perform board and system bring-up and hardware debugging using lab instruments (oscilloscope, multimeter, bench PSU, logic analyser).
* Oversee and quality-check assembly work by technical assistants — soldering, crimping, and harness build — and coordinate with EMS/assembly vendors.
* Support power distribution, grounding, and basic firmware/microcontroller interfacing as required.
* Produce and maintain documentation - schematics, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, BOMs, and test reports.

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience across electronics design and test, comfortable working in more than one area.
* Practical PCB design experience with a standard EDA tool (KiCad, Altium, or Eagle).
* Working knowledge of wiring, harnessing, crimping, and connector-assembly processes
* Comfortable with lab instruments and hardware debugging; able to read schematics and datasheets.
* Basic familiarity with microcontrollers and embedded interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, and similar).
* Fast learner - able to pick up new tools, processes, and problem areas quickly and move between tasks.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to robotics, marine, aerospace, or other regulated hardware domains.
* KiCad; embedded firmware (C/C++); sensor characterisation.
* Wire-harness documentation and cable-schedule experience.
* Experience through a full build-and-bring-up cycle to delivery.

**Why Join Rekise Marine**

* **Build the Hardware That Brings Autonomy to Life:**
  You will build the electrical, electronics, power systems, and firmware that run autonomous vessels across a range of applications — from our flagship Jalkapi XLAUV, a 20-ton submarine travelling 5,000+ kilometres underwater, on platforms operating from the coast to the deep sea. The challenge of building hardware that runs reliably for weeks, beneath the surface, is unlike anything else being built in India.
* **Mission Impact:**
  The electronics and firmware you build are the nervous system of vessels on live missions, including defence and security operations of national importance. Every board you design and every line of firmware you write directly shapes whether the platform performs, and returns safely.
* **Technical Ownership:**
  You will own the embedded and electrical stack from the ground up — hardware, power, firmware, integration, and bring-up.
* **Cross-Disciplinary Work:**
  Work at the intersection of electronics, power, mechanical, software, and robotics. Few embedded roles let you work this close to the full system you help bring to life.
* **Benefits:**
  Compensation at par with the best in the industry, health insurance for you and your family and other benefits.

* Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
* India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
* Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

* Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.

* Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.

Decision ownership:
  
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
  
Common capability baseline
  
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
  

* Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
* Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
* Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.

description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.

Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.

Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.

Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.

GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

* 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.

description:

Location Flexibility: Primary Location Only

Fujitsu’s R&D vision is to create cutting-edge technologies that support society and prioritize the flow of data. Our five key technologies are essential elements for collecting data from all parts of society, transporting it over ultra-high-speed and secure networks, analyzing it with trusted AI, converting it into value, and returning it to society. Central to realizing our strategy and vision are the people behind our R&D initiatives. We strive to foster top-notch talent in the innovation process by nurturing skilled individuals equipped to advance this cause with originality and dedication.
  
  
**Website:**
https://www.fujitsu.com/global/about/research/
  
  
**About us:**
At Fujitsu AI Lab, we are at the forefront of research, innovation, and product development in areas such as AI (artificial intelligence), Machine Learning (ML), and Data Science. Our technologies are integrated into Fujitsu’s products and customer systems across sectors like finance, telecommunications, manufacturing, healthcare, and social infrastructure. We are committed to shaping the future with cutting-edge AI research, driving advancements in fields such as Generative AI, Cognitive AI, Graph ML, ML models for complex temporal and multimodal data.
  
  
**Role Purpose As Research Manager/IC**

* Team Leadership: Manage a team of researchers, guiding them in developing innovative AI solutions, creating research proposals aligned with Fujitsu’s AI strategy, and collaborating with global teams and stakeholders.
* Project Execution: Lead technical execution and ensure timely delivery of research projects, support patent filings, and publication in top-tier conferences and journals.
* Hands-on Technical Work: Lead and participate in prototyping, algorithm development, and mathematical modelling to drive research.
* Business Collaboration: Work with business units to demonstrate new technologies, create use cases, and validate research outcomes.
* Mentorship and Leadership: Provide thought leadership, address technical challenges, and mentor the team to develop into future technical leaders.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Regularly update leadership on project progress and help expand research impact across business units.
* Global and Academic Collaboration: Serve as a domain expert for Global Research and build partnerships with academic institutions.
* Foster Excellence: Promote best practices to build an impactful, collaborative research team.

**Technical Skills**
We are seeking candidates with expertise in the following areas, along with a strong publication track record in top-tier conferences (e.g., A\\* conferences):
  
  
- Advanced AI Expertise:

* Deep understanding of fundamentals of AI models at theoretical and implementation level, theoretical machine learning, statistical theory of learning, AI Agents and multi-agentic systems and related technologies, and their practical implementation in various domains.
* Previous experience in research around Agentic and multi-agentic technologies such as self-adaptive, self-evolving, self-learning agents with world models, agentic memory etc is preferred. Good understanding of training algorithms, protocols and frameworks for Agentic systems is essential.
* Prior experience of testing Agents and multi-agent system in real-world environment is desirable.
* Up to date with the latest in AI algorithms & neural architectures (e.g., attention, transformers, state-space models, etc.) and their application to generative AI (LLMs), explainable AI, causal reasoning, knowledge representation, concept discovery & extraction, graph AI, etc. Hands-on training of LLM (SFT, RLHF etc.) is strongly desirable.
* Desirable: An ideal researcher is one capable of performing multi-disciplinary research, rapidly learn concepts in new domain, and apply to the problem in hand, is well-informed with latest conceptual advancements in the overall AI space, and able to include them in his ideas and project at speed
* Proficient in AI/ML Programming: Advanced skills in coding, working with AI/ML libraries, and familiar with major AI platforms and tools.

Custom Software Engineer

**Must have skills :**
SAP for Utilities Energy Data Management Device Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**

15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. The role requires working with contemporary development frameworks and following agile methodologies to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Collaboration with different stakeholders and continuous refinement of software elements to enhance performance and functionality are integral parts of the daily routine.

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead efforts to identify and implement process improvements that enhance team productivity and software quality.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and integration within the team.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP for Utilities Energy Data Management Device Management.
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycle and agile methodologies.
* Experience in designing and implementing scalable software architectures.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues effectively.
* Familiarity with integration of software components and third-party systems.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering business value.

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in SAP for Utilities Energy Data Management Device Management.
* This position is based at our MDC5C - SEZ office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Quality Engineer II
description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at 
www.syndigo.com
.

**\\*\\*This is a hybrid position that requires 3 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\\*\\***

Syndigo is looking for a 
**Quality Engineer II**
 to drive quality across the software development lifecycle for enterprise SaaS products. The role involves working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams to ensure high-quality product releases through both manual and automated testing.

**HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**

* Work closely with the product management and development teams and proactively build in quality across SDLC stages.

* Certify the functional and non-functional aspects using the QA best standards to deliver top quality products.

* Implement automation for API, Functional or UI features of the product by using the Java, Python & PlayWright based automation frameworks.

* Use AI / Generative AI to implement solutions for testing.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

* 3-6 years of total experience in testing enterprise software/product with 2+ years of experience in test automation for APIs, Integrations, and UI.

* Good exposure to AI (AI, Generative AI, prompt engineering, context design, models, evaluation, etc.).

* Proven experience with automating testing for REST or SOAP APIs and Integrations using necessary tools like RestAssured, Postman, Swagger, Katalon, JMeter, etc.

* Hands on experience with programming/scripting languages (Java, Python). Development or white box testing experience will be preferred.

* Working knowledge of web services, web applications, and related areas of non-functional testing like Performance, Scalability, etc.

* Hands-on with Github source control, Test Mgmt tools and JIRA, Confluence, etc.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively communicate with both product and technical teams.

* Experience working in CI/CD model with SaaS and Cloud technologies (Azure, AWS)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

 

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or relative work experience
* Working experience in Retail/E-Commerce domain or knowledge of MDM/PIM

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.  Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

**GDPR/CCPA**

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.
